spec.construction: counts over the label-free tsb_mol graph view; ratios are count/atoms or count/bonds
excluded_on_purpose: all 217 RDKit 2D descriptors (including BCUT / EState / VSA / fr_* / ring-count helpers)

graph_contract.chirality_representation: RDKit CIP code R/S/none (stable under atom renumbering)

parse_policy: strict RDKit parse; failure is a hard error, never a zero vector

timing.note: tokenization is a one-time shared cost for all 3 splits and all WL arms; per-arm assembly time is measured in the train stage
